text: André Aciman's Call Me By Your Name was hidden from sale by the online store Labirint in December 2022. In January 2023 it was permanently banned from libraries and classrooms in St. Johns County School District, and in September 2023 from libraries and classrooms in Matanuska-Susitna Borough School District. In June 2025 the state Education Commissioner wrote to the Hillsborough County school district that the book and one other were "pornographic", and the district superintendent was called to a Florida board of education meeting on June 4 about them.
